narrative: The AutoGPT SSRF bypass (CVE-2026-56663, fixed in 0.6.52) is the same SSRF-on-an-agent-gateway primitive this June 10 thesis tracks, remediated by constraining outbound egress. The Langflow cross-tenant IDOR fired in the wild (CVE-2026-55255, CVSS 9.9), chained on-instance with KEV-listed RCE CVE-2026-33017, reinforces the KEV-timeline thread: the proxy layer is generating actively-exploited maximum-severity CVEs.
remaining_gap: Fresh CVEs in this class, one chained with a KEV-listed RCE, but no named governance instrument designating AI inference proxies as a software class.
